nodes.question: How can e-waste be reduced through a replacement cycle and refurbishment?
nodes.answer: E-waste can be reduced through a replacement cycle and refurbishment by encouraging the reuse and refurbishment of electronic devices, extending their lifespan and reducing the amount of electronic waste generated.
